svg.text: A computer that knows what you want before you ask, and keeps it on your machine.
The same layers in all four places. Each one only talks to the one under it:
38 apps, each in its own walled-off memory, so one crash stays one crash
windows, dock and menu bar; Samantha runs what you type or say
takes turns between apps, stops one frozen for 3 s, files, network
screen, USB keyboard, mouse and mic, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, SD card, sound
a Raspberry Pi 4, a PC, or QEMU pretending to be one
Out on the internet: Turing (her brain), ElevenLabs (her voice), a Cloudflare Worker and Open-Meteo.

g.text: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU TALK TO SAMANTHA
HOW AN APP GETS ONTO THE PI (8.0)
Sealed apps run for anyone; unsealed ones (yours, or Samantha's) only for an admin; a broken seal never.
THE PI, ON THE REAL BOARD
Solid boxes are seen working on the real board (2026-10-12, v3); dashed are built and checked in QEMU, not yet seen there.
Terracotta: the newest piece. Drawn by tools/gen/map.py; the detail graphs live in docs/.
